description: Stone-walled vineyard terraces step down from the slope above Rivaz to Lake Geneva, with the village and the shore below. In late September the vines are turning yellow and gold at harvest, not full summer green. The Alps across the lake are only a faint shape under the overcast Open-Meteo model. The terraces are the subject, and Chillon Castle is not in the frame.
